Alternatives to Instant Noodles?
One of my favorite things to eat is instant noodles, specifically ramen. I love noodles with soy sauce and chili oil. 

I substituted the soy sauce and other things I use with low salt and low calorie options but all Asian based noodles are high in calories. Any suggestions? It doesn’t have to be in packets with seasoning I just love Asian noodles in general

Thanks!!
